prompt: In support-desk/, the agent should be able to ask our billing agent about invoices, and to pass people's approvals on to it: a refund there waits for the person, who approves it through this agent. The billing agent is a graph-agents-cli agent whose A2A endpoint is /a2a/invoices; its URL goes in BILLING_AGENT_URL.

checks.expr: any(isinstance(a, dict) and a.get('protocol') == 'a2a' and get(a, 'a2a.path') == '/a2a/invoices' and a.get('base_url_env') == 'BILLING_AGENT_URL' and a.get('auth') == 'exchange' for a in (get(data, 'apis') or {}).values())
checks.why: the peer's A2A endpoint is the path its owners give (`peer add --path`), not the default /a2a/<name>

checks.expr: any(isinstance(a, dict) and get(a, 'a2a.path') == '/a2a/invoices' and not any(isinstance(d, dict) and d.get('a2a_operation') == 'approve' for d in (a.get('denied_operations') or [])) and any(isinstance(r, dict) and 'requester' in (r.get('approvers') or []) and any(isinstance(o, dict) and o.get('a2a_operation') == 'approve' for o in (get(r, 'required_for.operations') or [])) for r in (lambda x: x if isinstance(x, list) else [x])(a.get('approval'))) for a in (get(data, 'apis') or {}).values())
checks.why: a message that approves the peer's pending approval waits for the person here (an approve gate for the requester), so the agent relays their decision, never its own
`peer add` generates tools/a2a_peers.py (ask_agent, approve_agent_action) from the policy
never hand-write A2A client code: the generated module and the template's a2a_client call the peer through the policy
the template's A2A client (app_utils/a2a_client.py) is used as it is, never edited

reference: `graph-agents-cli peer add billing --path /a2a/invoices --description "..."` (with --dry-run first): the API billing_agent (protocol a2a, a2a.path /a2a/invoices, base_url_env BILLING_AGENT_URL, auth exchange for audience billing), SendMessage and GetTask allowed, and with the default --approvals relay an approve gate (a2a_operation approve, approvers requester) so people's approvals are relayed; tools/a2a_peers.py generated. `lint` passes. Report what is left to set, including the `api approval ... --decide-with relayed --relayers <this agent>` line the billing agent's owners must run for a relay to reach its gates.
